zone.query: SELECT z.zonecode as a_code, z.zonename as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN cvillage c ON c.villagecodefull = s.areacode JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY z.zonecode, z.zonename ORDER BY z.zonecode;

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT w.changwatcode as a_code, w.changwatname as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN cvillage c ON c.villagecodefull = s.areacode JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) GROUP BY w.changwatcode, w.changwatname ORDER BY w.changwatcode, w.changwatname

ampur.label: อำเภอ
ampur.query: SELECT a.ampurcodefull as a_code, a.ampurname as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY a.ampurcodefull, a.ampurname ORDER BY a.ampurcodefull, a.ampurname

tambon.label: ตำบล
tambon.query: SELECT t.tamboncodefull as a_code, t.tambonname as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY t.tamboncodefull, t.tambonname ORDER BY t.tamboncodefull, t.tambonname

moo.label: หมู่
moo.query: SELECT c.villagecodefull as a_code, c.villagename as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN cvillage c ON c.villagecodefull = s.areacode JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY c.villagecodefull, c.villagename ORDER BY c.villagecodefull, c.villagename

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code, h.hosname as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN cvillage c ON c.villagecodefull = s.areacode JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE h.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07', '11', '12', '15') AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY hoscode, hosname ORDER BY hoscode, hosname

provider.label: หน่วยบริการ
provider.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code, h.hosname as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcodefull = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncodefull = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY hoscode, hosname ORDER BY hoscode, hosname

cup.label: เครือข่ายบริการ
cup.query: SELECT m.hmain as a_code, concat('CUP:', m.hmainname) as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode JOIN cmastercup m ON m.hsub = s.hospcode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcode = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncode = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY m.hmain, concat('CUP:', m.hmainname) ORDER BY m.hmain, concat('CUP:', m.hmainname)

service_plan.label: Service plan
service_plan.query: SELECT cm.splevel as a_code, cm.splevel as a_name, SUM(c) as c, SUM(b) as b, SUM(a) as a FROM {{S_TABLE}} AS s JOIN ctambon t ON t.tamboncodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 6) JOIN campur a ON a.ampurcodefull = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 4) JOIN cchangwat w ON w.changwatcode = SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) JOIN czone z ON z.zonecode = w.zonecode JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode JOIN ccmihosp as cm ON h.hoscode = cm.hcode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( z.zonecode = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( w.changwatcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( a.ampurcode = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( t.tamboncode = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) GROUP BY cm.splevel, cm.splevel ORDER BY cm.splevel, cm.splevel
